# Phase Three — Migration Plan

> Migration should be a bridge, not a flood; the Awtsmoos.com river keeps old vessels afloat while one clearer current carries new code.

## Additive path

1. Existing users of `createUniversalAwtsmoosApi()` continue unchanged.
2. Existing Creation Portal users continue unchanged.
3. Existing Procedural Portal users continue unchanged.
4. New users may adopt `createAwtsmoos()` for the five-verb lifecycle.
5. Expert users obtain existing authorities through namespaces instead of importing a new parallel framework.

## Bridge policy

- Procedural-language definition remains canonical per entity.
- `awtsmoos.world.v1` remains canonical project/world serialization.
- ModelingDocument, Nature, Reality, materials, ProceduralObject and adapters continue lowering through existing bridges.
- No deprecation is declared unless an existing path is truly replaced and migration tests exist.
- No format-version bump is made for a facade-only convergence release.

## Compatibility proof

Run current suites for Universal Semantic Kernel, compiler chain, execution, Creation Portal, Procedural Portal federation, ModelingDocument, Nature, Reality, materials, transactions/history, world serialization, and adapter capability reporting. New tests must additionally compare old direct APIs with equivalent expert namespaces on the new facade.
